idea: Natural Gas Heating Demand Spike During Cold Snaps

data.source: Open-Meteo daily temperature data for major US heating zones combined with FRED natural gas spot prices (series: DHHNGSP)

behavior: When daily temperatures drop 15+ degrees below rolling 30-day average in winter months, natural gas futures spike sharply within 1-3 days, creating a predictable short-term commodity demand signal.

market_impact.rationale: Energy sector benefits from heating demand spikes and elevated commodity input costs that lift valuations.

trade_logic.entry: If daily temperature drops >15°F below 30-day rolling average AND FRED DHHNGSP rises >5% in one week, enter long XLE
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 7 trading days or when temperature recovers within 10°F of rolling average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Winter heating season runs through March; cold snaps occur multiple times per winter and reliably trigger gas price spikes within days.

idea: Freight Rate Volatility Spike From Port Queue Backlog

data.source: Port container volume data from existing port_container_volume adapter (major US ports: LA, Long Beach, New York, Savannah) tracking weekly volumes

behavior: When weekly container volumes spike 20%+ above 12-week average (indicating congestion), freight rates and logistics demand jump within 3-5 days as shippers rush to secure capacity.

market_impact.rationale: Industrials and shipping companies see margin expansion and demand surge when freight congestion drives rate hikes.

trade_logic.entry: If aggregate US port TEU volume jumps >20% above 12-week average, enter long XLI
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or when volume normalizes below 110% of 12-week average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Port congestion is seasonal and episodic; volume spikes fire several times per quarter, especially post-holiday and pre-tariff rush periods.

idea: Labor Market Weakness Reflected in ADP Employment Miss

data.source: FRED ADP Employment data (series: EMPSAPCOMP) published monthly, historical daily interpolation via price_only adapter on SPY volatility around release dates

behavior: When ADP employment growth drops >100k below prior month or 2-month average, market reprices Fed rate-cut expectations, creating bullish rotation into XLV and defensive sectors within 2-5 days.

market_impact.rationale: Weaker labor data signals lower-for-longer rates, benefiting defensive healthcare valuations over cyclicals.

trade_logic.entry: If latest ADP print is >100k below 2-month average, enter long XLV and short XLY equally weighted
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 7 trading days or when next major labor report (NFP) is released

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: ADP reports monthly; misses occur 3-4 times per year on average, and market reacts within days.

idea: Earthquake Swarm Aftershock Insurance & Building Stock Volatility

data.source: USGS earthquake_activity API tracking daily seismic events magnitude >3.5 in populated US zones (California, Pacific Northwest)

behavior: When a magnitude 5.0+ earthquake occurs or a swarm of 10+ events in 3 days triggers aftershock warnings, construction/materials stocks (XLB, XLRE) and insurance-linked instruments see demand spikes as repairs and building inspections accelerate.

market_impact.rationale: Materials demand rises from emergency repairs; construction and building materials experience near-term demand boost.

trade_logic.entry: If USGS reports magnitude 5.0+ quake OR 10+ events magnitude >3.5 in 3-day window in California/PNW, enter long XLB
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or when aftershock warning expires

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: California and Pacific Northwest experience multiple notable seismic events per year; swarms fire several times annually.

idea: Google Trends Surge in 'Recession Fear' Drives Defensive Rotation

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for terms: 'recession outlook', 'economic slowdown', 'job cuts news' via google_trends adapter

behavior: When weekly Google Trends for recession-related searches spike >30% above rolling 8-week average, consumer sentiment deteriorates and equity allocators rotate from XLY to XLP/XLV within 3-7 days.

market_impact.rationale: Rising recession anxiety triggers flight-to-safety; consumer discretionary underperforms as allocation shifts to staples and healthcare.

trade_logic.entry: If Google Trends composite score for recession-fear keywords jumps >30% above 8-week rolling average, short XLY and long XLP equally
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or when Trends score reverts below 120% of rolling average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Recession anxiety spikes episodically; market uncertainty triggers multiple Trends surges per quarter.

idea: EV Charger Network Rollout Acceleration Signals Clean Energy Tailwind

data.source: OpenChargeMap API weekly charger count snapshots across major US metro areas (density metric: chargers per 1000 EVs)

behavior: When weekly charger deployment accelerates >15% above 12-week average (signaling investment phase), clean energy and EV-linked equities (XLK, XLI) outperform as infrastructure demand becomes tangible.

market_impact.rationale: Infrastructure buildout boosts industrial/materials demand; signals policy tailwinds for clean energy transition.

trade_logic.entry: If aggregate US charger count grows >15% week-over-week above 12-week average, enter long XLI
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 14 trading days or when growth rate falls below 105% of 12-week average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Charger deployment follows predictable quarterly government funding cycles; multiple acceleration phases per year.

idea: Credit Spread Widening From High-Yield Bond Stress Signals Recession Risk

data.source: FRED high-yield OAS spread (series: BAMLH0A0HYM2) daily data via price_only adapter tracking relative widening vs 60-day average

behavior: When daily HY OAS widens >50 bps above 60-day moving average and closes above it, credit stress spikes signal equity risk-off; cyclical sectors (XLI, XLY) underperform XLV.

market_impact.rationale: Credit stress signals deteriorating corporate health and recession fears; industrials and discretionary suffer first.

trade_logic.entry: If BAMLH0A0HYM2 spreads >50 bps above 60-day MA and holds for 2 consecutive days, short XLI and long XLV
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 7 trading days or when spreads contract back below 130% of 60-day MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: HY spreads widen episodically; events fire multiple times per quarter during volatility spikes.

idea: Airline Load Factor Compression Signals Travel Demand Weakness

data.source: BTS airline load factor data weekly via bts_airline_load_factor adapter tracking major US carriers

behavior: When aggregate US airline load factor drops >3 percentage points below 13-week average (indicating lower-than-expected travel demand), XLY travel/leisure stocks see selling pressure within 3-5 days.

market_impact.rationale: Falling load factors signal weakening consumer travel demand, impacting discretionary spending outlook.

trade_logic.entry: If BTS aggregate load factor drops >3 ppts below 13-week rolling average, short XLY
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or when load factor rebounds above 101% of 13-week average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Airline data is published weekly; demand shocks trigger load factor drops multiple times per quarter seasonally.

idea: Electricity Demand Surge From Extreme Heat Signals Energy Sector Strength

data.source: EIA electricity demand data (series: EMRATIO) weekly via eia_electricity adapter combined with Open-Meteo daily heat stress index

behavior: When weekly electricity demand spikes >10% above rolling 12-week average AND heat index exceeds 95°F for 3+ consecutive days, energy stocks surge as peak pricing and margin expansion material.

market_impact.rationale: Peak electricity demand during heat waves drives higher wholesale prices and utility margins; energy sector benefits.

trade_logic.entry: If EIA electricity demand >10% above 12-week average AND regional heat index >95°F for 3+ days, enter long XLE
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or when demand normalizes below 105% of 12-week average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Heat waves are seasonal; summer months (June-Sept) produce multiple 3+ day heat stress events per year.

idea: Corporate Earnings Revision Downgrade Cascade From RSS News Volume Surge

data.source: RSS feed aggregator tracking earnings-miss and guidance-cut keywords from major financial news sources (Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC) via rss_count adapter, daily frequency

behavior: When daily RSS count for 'earnings miss' + 'guidance cut' spikes >50% above 20-day average, market reprices growth expectations downward; XLK and XLI see early selling pressure within 2-4 days.

market_impact.rationale: Earnings revisions sentiment is a leading indicator; downgrades signal deteriorating corporate fundamentals.

trade_logic.entry: If RSS count for earnings-miss/guidance-cut keywords rises >50% above 20-day MA on 2 consecutive days, short XLK
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 7 trading days or when RSS count falls below 120% of 20-day MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Earnings seasons and ad-hoc guidance cuts generate recurring RSS surges; events fire multiple times per quarter.
